welcome.workspaceReady: Your workspace is ready. You have full access to Custoray.
welcome.trialNoticeBody: Your {{plan}} trial is complimentary through {{date}}. You will not be billed before then.

welcome.trialBody: Use this time to set up your company, books, and first products. You will not be billed until the trial ends.

guide.companyLead: These details appear on invoices, PDFs, and your storefront.
guide.companyBody: Start with your trading name. You can refine the rest anytime in Settings.
guide.companyTaglinePlaceholder: Short line under your name on documents
guide.termLead: Choose how long this period should run. Sales, stock, and reports stay in this term until you close it.
guide.termBody: Pick a length that matches how you close your books. Twelve months is the usual financial year.
guide.termOption6: Half year — close books twice a year.
guide.termOption12: Financial year — standard for most businesses.
guide.termOption24: Two years — keep books open longer.
guide.termHint: You can change this later from Year closing.
guide.displayBody: Choose the look and feel that works for you.
guide.productLead: A name and price are enough to start. You can add more later from Inventory.
guide.productBody: This product will appear in sales, POS, and inventory.
guide.listsBody: By invoice shows one row per bill (by customer). By item shows one row per product line. You can still switch this on each page.
guide.listBillHint: One row per bill, grouped by customer.
guide.readyBody: Your workspace is set. Open the dashboard to add products and start selling.
